## Mandatory attestations
- [ ] **No** restricted/identifiable/DUA-controlled/IRB data was entered into any external AI tool
- [ ] All AI-assisted **code** was read, understood, and tested by me
- [ ] All **citations** were independently verified to exist and to support the claim
- [ ] All **numbers/stats** were independently verified
- [ ] No data or results were fabricated, altered, or "cleaned" by AI
- [ ] I can explain and defend every claim as if no AI were involved
- [ ] AI tools are **not** listed as authors
